about: The bench gate's baseline (xtask/src/ratchet.rs). Written only by cargo xtask bench --update-baseline, in a commit that says why.

linux-x86_64.reason: First Linux entry (W8b-i), from the development container on the owner's machine, not the CI runner; times are not gated until the runner writes its own

windows-x86_64.reason: First Windows entry (W8b-i), measured on the owner's 64 GB machine while other agents were building; times are not gated
